requirements.quote: An assistant to physician who is issued a temporary license under this section shall apply for a license to practice as an assistant to physician pursuant to Section 34-24-297 within 12 months after the issuance of a temporary license.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices or offers to practice as an assistant to physician in this state without a license and registration issued and approved by the board shall be guilty of a misdemeanor which shall be punishable as provided by law.

title_protection.quote: That the assistant to physician has represented himself or herself or permitted another to represent him or her as a physician.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers to practice as an assistant to physician in this state without a license and registration issued and approved by the board shall be guilty of a misdemeanor which shall be punishable as provided by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime or offense reflecting on ability to render patient care safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime or other offense, felony, or misdemeanor, reflecting on the ability of the individual to render patient care in a safe manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any violation of state or federal laws relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any violation of state or federal laws relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination, restriction, suspension, revocation, or curtailment of licensure in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Termination, restriction, suspension, revocation, or curtailment of licensure, registration, or certification as an assistant to physician by another state or other licensing jurisdiction on grounds similar to those stated herein.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial of a registration, certification, or license to practice as assistant to physician by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The denial of a registration, a certification, or a license to practice as an assistant to physician by another state or other licensing jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to render patient care with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance abuse, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to render patient care with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, inebriation, addiction to, or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, chemicals, drugs, or any other substance, or by reason of a mental or physical condition or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, termination, suspension, or restriction of hospital privileges.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, termination, suspension, or restriction of hospital privileges.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly submitting or causing to be submitted any false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading information to the board in connection with an application for licensure or registration as an assistant to physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself or permitting another to represent one as a physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the assistant to physician has represented himself or herself or permitted another to represent him or her as a physician.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services other than at the direction and under the supervision of a board-approved physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the assistant to physician has performed otherwise than at the direction and under the supervision of a physician approved by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or attempting to perform tasks and functions beyond competence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the assistant to physician has been delegated or has performed or attempted to perform tasks and functions beyond his or her competence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing tasks beyond those authorized in the approved job description.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the assistant to physician has performed or attempted to perform tasks beyond those authorized in the approved job description.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or permitting another to practice as an assistant to physician without the required license and registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or permitting another to practice as an assistant to physician without the required license and registration from the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing in violation of statutory authority or board rules or guidelines.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing by an assistant to physician in violation of statutory authority or board rules or guidelines.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional falsification of a certification of compliance with continuing medical education requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional falsification of a certification of compliance with the continuing medical education requirement for assistants to physicians established in the board rules.

definition_quote.value: A person who is a graduate of an approved program, is licensed by the board, and is registered by the board to perform medical services under the supervision of a physician approved by the board to supervise the assistant.
definition_quote.quote: ASSISTANT TO PHYSICIAN. A person who is a graduate of an approved program, is licensed by the board, and is registered by the board to perform medical services under the supervision of a physician approved by the board to supervise the assistant.

value: performing medical services under physician supervision
prescribing legend drugs per approved job description
administering legend drugs authorized under job description
methods_authorized.quote: a licensed assistant to a physician may perform medical services when the services are rendered under the supervision of a licensed physician or physicians approved by the board

drug_authority.value: May prescribe legend drugs authorized in an approved job description signed by supervising physician; drugs must be on the board-approved formulary. May not prescribe controlled substances. Prescriptive privileges not granted under temporary license.
drug_authority.quote: A licensed assistant to a physician registered to a licensed physician practicing under a job description approved in the manner prescribed by this article may prescribe legend drugs to patients, subject to both of the following conditions: (1) The drug type, dosage, quantity prescribed, and number of refills shall be authorized in an approved job description signed by the physicians to whom the assistant is registered. (2) The drug shall be on the formulary approved under the guidelines of the Board of Medical Examiners.

citations.kind: scope of practice and drug authority

supervising_anesthesiologist_physical_pr.quote: The term supervision does not require direct on-site supervision of the assistant to the physician; however, it does require the professional oversight and direction as may be required by the regulations and guidelines of the Board of Medical Examiners.

written_practice_protocol_required.quote: PHYSICIAN SUPERVISION. A formal relationship between a licensed assistant to a physician and a licensed physician under which the assistant to the physician is authorized to practice as evidenced by a written job description approved in accordance with this article.

prescribing_authority.quote: Assistants to physicians granted a temporary license will not be granted prescriptive privileges, allowed to practice without direct, on-site physician supervision, or allowed to practice in a remote practice site.

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.value: Must be a physician licensed to practice medicine in this state and approved by the Board of Medical Examiners to supervise assistants to physicians.
supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: PHYSICIAN. A person who is licensed to practice medicine in this state and is approved by the board to supervise assistants to physicians.

national_certification_body.value: National Commission for Certification of Anesthesiologist Assistants (NCCAA)
national_certification_body.quote: the National Certifying Examination for Anesthesiologist Assistants (NCEAA) as administered by the National Commission for Certification of Anesthesiologist Assistants (NCCAA).

accredited_training_program_required.quote: Provide evidence, satisfactory to the board, of successful completion of a training program accredited by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation (CAHEA) , the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP), the Accreditation Review Commission on Education for the Physician Assistant (ARC-PA), or the Accreditation Review Committee for the Anesthesiologist Assistant (ARC-AA), or their successor agencies.

student_trainee_exemption.quote: TRAINEE. A person who is currently enrolled in an approved program in this state.

supervising_anesthesiologist_liability.quote: an assistant to a physician shall be conclusively presumed to be the agent, servant, or employee solely of the licensed physician or physicians under whose supervision he or she performs the service, and no other person, firm, corporation, or other organization shall be held liable or responsible for any act or omission of the assistant arising out of the performance of the medical service.
